meta.subject: fixed memory flags propagation through the cache hierarchy

en.summary: This commit fixes cache-hierarchy request metadata handling by propagating the full memory-flag vector through cache wrappers, banks, and request queues instead of collapsing it to a flush bit.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly names a correctness bug in the cache hierarchy.
The patch threads FLAGS_WIDTH through top-level cache instantiations, cache wrappers, cache banks, and memory-request queues.
Request flags drive special memory semantics such as flush, IO, and local-memory handling, so dropping them changes DUT behavior.
evidence: hw/rtl/Vortex.sv, hw/rtl/VX_cluster.sv, and hw/rtl/VX_socket.sv start instantiating caches with FLAGS_WIDTH set to MEM_REQ_FLAGS_WIDTH.
hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache.sv replaces the old mem_req_flush signal with full-width mem_req_flags and forwards those flags onto the memory bus.
hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_bank.sv stores core_req_flags through the pipeline and emits mreq_queue_flags through the memory-request queue.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Caches and memory adapters must preserve request attribute bits as a request moves through arbitration, buffering, miss handling, and writeback machinery. If those attributes are narrowed to a single flush bit, zeroed, or otherwise stripped, downstream logic can no longer distinguish cacheable versus special requests such as IO, local-memory, or flush operations. That changes routing and handling semantics even when the address and data are otherwise correct.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: Memory-request attribute propagation through the cache hierarchy
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A request carrying non-default metadata such as flush, IO, or local-memory attributes passes through one or more cache stages before reaching memory or a bypass path.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Drop or truncate request-flag bits while buffering or repacking cache requests, so only a subset of the metadata survives to later stages.
portability_notes: Map this to any cache, miss queue, bypass path, or memory adapter that repacks requests into an internal format.
The essential mutation is metadata loss during transport, not an address-translation bug.
If the target DUT uses different flag names, apply the fault to any bits that distinguish special memory semantics from normal cached access.
concrete_injection_steps: Reduce the internal flag bus width at a cache boundary or internal queue so only one control bit, or zero bits, are carried forward.
When packing requests into a bank pipeline or memory-request queue, preserve only flush-like state and discard other attribute bits.
Keep downstream special-case logic unchanged so it consumes incomplete metadata and exhibits misrouting or mis-handling.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Cache request flag plumbing and memory-request queue packing
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds FLAGS_WIDTH parameters to cache instantiations, replaces single-bit flush propagation with full-width flag propagation, and stores request flags through cache-bank pipelines and memory-request queues.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_cache.sv and VX_cache_bank.sv, revert mem_req_flags and core_req_flags back toward a single flush-style signal when packing requests and when driving the memory bus; in upper-level wrappers, instantiate cache stages with FLAGS_WIDTH = 0 or 1 instead of MEM_REQ_FLAGS_WIDTH.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Special memory requests are routed or handled as ordinary cached accesses, or flush requests lose auxiliary semantics, leading to incorrect cache behavior, wrong bypass decisions, or broken local-memory and IO handling.
evidence_for_injection: The patch consistently replaces single flush-bit storage with full-width flag storage across multiple cache stages.
Existing cache bypass and local-memory logic in the tree already consumes distinct MEM_REQ_FLAG bits, so flag loss is behaviorally meaningful.
The request metadata is explicitly carried through the cache-bank request queue after the fix, which provides a concrete reinjection point.
notes: This fault is most visible on workloads that mix normal cached traffic with IO, local-memory, or explicit flush traffic.
The cache-bank request queue is the most direct injection anchor because it sits after arbitration but before external memory emission.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了缓存层级中的请求元数据处理问题：完整的内存标志位向量现在会穿过 cache wrapper、cache bank 和请求队列传播，而不是被压缩成单独的 flush 位。
why_it_counts: 提交信息直接指出缓存层级中的正确性问题。
补丁把 FLAGS_WIDTH 贯穿到顶层缓存实例、cache wrapper、cache bank 以及内存请求队列。
这些请求标志控制 flush、IO、本地内存等特殊语义，丢失它们会改变 DUT 行为。
evidence: hw/rtl/Vortex.sv、hw/rtl/VX_cluster.sv 和 hw/rtl/VX_socket.sv 开始以 MEM_REQ_FLAGS_WIDTH 实例化缓存。
hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache.sv 用全宽 mem_req_flags 替换了旧的 mem_req_flush，并把这些标志直接送到内存总线。
hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_bank.sv 在流水线中保存 core_req_flags，并通过 memory-request queue 输出 mreq_queue_flags。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 缓存和内存适配器必须在仲裁、缓冲、miss 处理和写回路径中保留请求属性位。如果这些属性被缩成单个 flush 位、被清零，或在传输中被剥离，下游逻辑就无法再区分普通可缓存访问与 IO、本地内存、flush 等特殊请求。即使地址和数据本身正确，请求的路由和处理语义仍会被改变。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 缓存层级中的内存请求属性传播
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 带有 flush、IO 或本地内存等非默认元数据的请求在到达内存或 bypass 路径前经过一个或多个缓存阶段。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在缓存请求的缓冲或重打包过程中丢弃或截断请求标志位，使只有部分元数据能进入后续阶段。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何会把请求重打包成内部格式的 cache、miss queue、bypass 路径或内存适配器。
该故障的本质是在传输过程中丢失元数据，而不是地址翻译出错。
如果目标 DUT 使用不同的标志命名，只要这些位用于区分特殊内存语义和普通缓存访问，就可以施加该故障。
concrete_injection_steps: 在某个缓存边界或内部队列处缩减内部 flag 总线宽度，只保留一个控制位或者直接不保留任何位。
把请求打包进 bank 流水线或 memory-request queue 时，只保留类似 flush 的状态而丢弃其他属性位。
保持下游特殊处理逻辑不变，让它消费不完整的元数据并表现出错误路由或错误处理。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 缓存请求标志位布线与内存请求队列打包逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复为缓存实例加入 FLAGS_WIDTH 参数，用全宽标志传播替换单 bit flush 传播，并在 cache-bank 流水线和 memory-request queue 中保存请求标志。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_cache.sv 和 VX_cache_bank.sv 中，把 mem_req_flags 和 core_req_flags 改回类似单独 flush 信号的实现；在上层 wrapper 中把 FLAGS_WIDTH 从 MEM_REQ_FLAGS_WIDTH 改成 0 或 1。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 特殊内存请求会被当成普通缓存访问来路由或处理，或者 flush 请求丢失附加语义，导致缓存行为错误、bypass 判定错误，或本地内存与 IO 处理失效。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁在多个缓存阶段中一致地把单个 flush 位替换成全宽 flag 存储。
代码树中已有 cache bypass 和本地内存逻辑会消费不同的 MEM_REQ_FLAG 位，因此丢标志具有明确的行为后果。
修复后这些元数据会显式穿过 cache-bank 请求队列，这提供了具体的回注位置。
notes: 当工作负载混合普通缓存流量与 IO、本地内存、显式 flush 流量时，该故障最容易暴露。
cache-bank 的 request queue 是最直接的注入点，因为它位于仲裁之后、外部内存发射之前。
